games.title: 8 bit Chess
games.description: 8 bit chess is your everyday online chess game made in the 8 bit art-style. Play against your friends or bots and enjoy your favorite game anytime you have access to a browser. multiplayer with friends works via local hosting and joining your friends hosted game with a room code.

games.title: 8 Bit Tag
games.description: tag is a universal childhood game and 8 bit tag aims to capture that experience in a 2d arcade style game with your friends. you can play with a large party of friends, every round is 2 minutes and their is 10 rounds in a game. If you are tagged than you are it! and if your it when the timer runs out, you lost the round.

games.title: A Pets 9 to 5
games.description: A pets 9 to 5 is a collection of mini games that emulate what different animals jobs are at a farm house, you have the options to play as a dog, cat, snake, bunny, owl or parrot each with their own chores and tasks. this game is a great way to pass time and see how high your score can get!!!

games.title: Aces Arcade
games.description: Aces arcade is a series of card games digitally translated to a 8 bit style where you can play your poker or solitaire among other famous game.

games.title: Ball Parkour
games.description: Ball parkour is a game based on players stamina, you control a ball and try not to fall off the edge as it gets faster and more obstacles appear in your path. try to make it as long as you can and the top of the screen will record how far you go, always try to beat your own personal best!!!

games.title: BALLISTIC
games.description: Ballistic is a "beat em up" side-scroller that stays faithful to the classic arcade style. You play either solo or with a duo and try to progress by using various weapons and your fists against waves of enemies from every corner from the street life, follow along with the story and see how far you can make it.

games.title: Belfry Bat
games.description: Belfry Bat is a stamina based game where the player must keep the bat in the middle of the screen, the bat will constantly fall and if it falls to far before hitting space and flapping upward then it shall hit an obstacle or the ground. the game keeps a score of how far you make it each time, always try to beat your personal best!

games.title: Block Party
games.description: Block party is a party game meant for a bunch of friends to hop on and avoid getting squashed by blocks from the sky, the blocks fall down and stack and the round ends when you reach the top, their are all kinds of little weapons around the map that spawn routinely that you can use against other players to keep everyone on their toes!!

games.title: Cob and Dune
games.description: Cob and Dune is a co op game meant for 2 friends to progress through series of levels that require team work, problem solving, and a cool temper. You and your friend make it throughout the levels by using your characters unique trait, cob is a clay monster and dune is a sand monster.

games.title: Dead Chamber
games.description: Dead chamber is a part of the Dead series, it is a gun game that you can play with either friends or bots. you run around all kinds of maps available and select any gun out of shot guns, smgs, rifles and AR's not to mention of course snipers, whichever one you pick doesn't matter, all that matters is how good you are at using them to get the highest score on the score board. if you get bored their is also a campaign that you can play alone or with a friend also via room code.

games.title: Dead Scope
games.description: Dead scope is a part of the dead series, it is the first game in this series and features all kinds of maps with snipers only!! if you wanna work on your scoping without the hassle of other guns, jump in and see who is the best marksman between you and your friends. if you have no friends, their are also bots!

games.title: Ghost Road
games.description: Ghost road is a horror game that you can play with your friends and reach quotas together for your museum. in this game, the player is a ghost hunter who rides around in a black muscle car that rides from town to town busting ghosts, each of these towns has haunted relics to collect and bring back to the museum.

games.title: Grave Rush
games.description: Grave Rush is the first ever game added to the gamekade. it is a simple arcade game where you try to survive as many rounds of zombie waves as you can, throughout the rounds you can upgrade weapons, pick up new weapons, use perks and every round you must refill your ammo, but be careful with your shots, you get enough ammo to kill as many zombies that spawn, no more, no less.

games.title: Grave Rush 3D
games.description: Grave Rush 3d is Grave rush translated to the 3d world with the addition of multiplayer. it is a simple arcade game where you try to survive as many rounds of zombie waves as you can, throughout the rounds you can upgrade weapons, pick up new weapons, use perks and every round you must refill your ammo, but be careful with your shots, you get enough ammo to kill as many zombies that spawn, no more, no less.

games.title: Hit Man Pie
games.description: In Hit Man Pie, you play as Rocco the raccoon, your a hit man hired by RJ the squirl, each round you are given a list of the people to hit with your pie gun, you must aim in and move around the building tops for the best most clear shot, but hit the wrong person shame on you, hit enough you'll end up in the slammer.

games.title: Keystone Drift
games.description: Keystone drift is a passion project that is constantly being updated, it is a driving game based in a real life area in Pennsylvania with crazy twisty roads and normal highways, drive where you will and drive fast enough and smart enough to evade the cops, you get the options of 2 pov's, 3rd person from the back of the car, and hitting v will switch the pov to 1st person in the drivers seat.

games.title: Knightmares
games.description: Knightmares is a solo horror game where you play as a knight who must uncover the mystery of what has happened in the kingdom, you go around collecting books with keys you are given at the start of each round. Each key acts as a compass after holding it for a certain amount of time, but every second you hold the key it calls Them.....

games.title: Meme Fighter
games.description: meme fighter is a collection of all your favorite brain rot memes thrown into a giant combat tournament, select anyone in the selection screen and give all those characters a good brawl. learn combos and special moves to finish them off once you have drained their health bar to zero.

games.title: Monolith Dominion
games.description: Monolith Dominion is a civilization game where you and other civilizations live side by side developing farm land, and your economy for resources to use for raising armies and preparing your people for defending the civilization you have created. if you have a stale mate with another civilization you can create a building to end the game in 15 minutes.

games.title: Monsters vs Androids
games.description: Monsters vs Androids is a mobile or computer game where you must use your monster characters to defend your selected map from androids, the androids come in waves and each monster has a different power to help defend yourself from letting the androids through. The androids themselves has their own abilities that will be an issue unless the player is capable to adapt. make sure to watch out for the boss androids.

games.title: Pantheon Clash
games.description: Pantheon clash is a brawling game where you and your friends can play in giant party lobby's or against bots, or even a normal 1v1. the characters are a collection from various mythological religions across the world. you can play as Sun Wukong using his staff to take on Ares and his war axe!!!

games.title: RJ's 8 Bit Pool
games.description: This is a standard port of pool made in the 8 bit style, play against your friends or bots and relax with some good old fashioned pool.
